capability: Build it twice; the mismatch points at the joint
title: Find the joint that slipped.

hook.picture: Close on the whale watching a tree of grey cards build up to one result card at the root.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The answer's wrong, and I can't tell which step.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: researcher debugging a multi-step agent run

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many trees, each with a cross at its root. Three more wrong roots, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; the whale searches faster each time and finds nothing.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One answer gives no place to look.

stakes.body: Every wrong answer means rereading the whole run, and fixes land in the wrong place.

solution_hint: Build it twice. Compare at every joint.

metaphor.body: Build the same answer twice, once through the parts and once straight from the brief, and lay the two trees side by side; wherever they differ, that joint lights, like comparing two maps of the same street.

steps.picture: A second tree ghosts in beside the first, built straight from the brief with one card per branch.
steps.sound: A second voice enters, an octave up

steps.picture: The two trees hang side by side.
steps.words: Once by parts. Once straight from the brief.

steps.picture: Joint by joint, the two trees are compared; teal ticks walk up both.
Push-in: one joint glows rust; the two builds disagree there.
The whale rebuilds only that branch; the joint turns teal.
The fixed joint holds its tick.
steps.words: The joint that disagrees: the weak seam.

real_case.claim: wiring-and-the-whole E5 audit: "4/10 trees were decomposition theater, caught label-free by universal inconsistency." Principle from the operad page, Law 6: disagreement localises the unstable seam.

honest_limit.picture: Both trees carry the same card with the same rust smudge inside; every joint compares equal, all ticks teal, and the pod still answers with a cross.
honest_limit.words: Both builds share the same bad card.

not_this.body: Matching builds can still be wrong.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the whale over the same tree, the root wrong again. This time one joint lights at once and the whale swims straight to it.
ending_pattern.callback: The search that found nothing in bar 3 now finds one joint in a beat, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Build it two ways. Look where they differ.
